Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Hyperlight / Redwood Inference

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of needs:
- Real-time inference for customer-facing features (sub-200ms 95th pctl)
- Multi-tenant routing with tenant isolation and per-tenant cost controls
- Audit logging and SOC2-aligned controls for regulated data

What we discussed from Hyperlight:
- Primary initial use case: personalization pipeline (web + mobile)
- Expected Q1 rollout for pilot; current gating items: procurement + legal review
- Success criteria: latency <200ms p95, <$0.50 per 1k requests in pilot run

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share a short mutual action plan and an SLA worksheet for review (attached).
2) If procurement/legal want a short call, we can do a 30-min intro with our security lead.
3) Tentative pilot target: start by end of Q4 — confirm by Nov 1.

Attachments: Hyperlight_Redwood_discovery_summary.pdf (discovery notes + SLA worksheet)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with your procurement or engineering leads.

Best,
